# AlaTex Landscaping — Comprehensive AI Reference

> Landscaping, landscape construction, drainage, retaining walls, outdoor lighting, and sprinkler repair for residential and commercial properties across Greater Birmingham and West Alabama.

---

## Company Overview

**AlaTex Landscaping** is a full-service landscaping company serving the Greater Birmingham metro and West Alabama. Owner-operated by Bryan Moore, AlaTex began as a sprinkler repair business and grew into a complete residential and commercial landscaping operation covering landscape construction, drainage, retaining walls, outdoor lighting, irrigation, and ongoing maintenance. The company is fully licensed and insured.

- **Owner**: Bryan Moore
- **Phone**: (205) 310-0553
- **Email**: Bryan@alatexlandscaping.com
- **Website**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com
- **Service region**: Greater Birmingham & West Alabama, Alabama

---

## Core Services

### Landscape Construction
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/landscape-construction

Design and construction of the built elements of a landscape — patios, walkways, paver hardscapes, outdoor living spaces, fire features, seating walls, grading, soil preparation, sod, and full planting installation — for residential and commercial properties.

### Retaining Walls
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/retaining-walls

Engineered retaining walls that control erosion, create usable yard space, and protect foundations. Includes segmental block walls, natural boulder walls, poured-in-place and reinforced structural walls, terracing and seating walls, and repair of failing or leaning walls. Every wall is built with proper drainage to relieve hydrostatic pressure — essential in the Birmingham metro's red-clay soils.

### Drainage & French Drain Installation
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/french-drain-installation

Drainage systems that eradicate standing water, manage hydrostatic pressure, and prevent foundation and landscape erosion. Includes French drains, surface and subsurface drains, regrading and swales, catch basins, and channel drains.

### Outdoor Lighting
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/outdoor-lighting

Low-voltage landscape and architectural lighting for beauty, safety, and security. Includes garden and landscape lighting design, path and step lighting, uplighting for trees and facades, smart app/timer-controlled systems, and energy-efficient LED installation and repair.

### Sprinkler Repair
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/sprinkler-repair

Fast repair, tuning, and upgrades for irrigation and sprinkler systems — broken and misaligned head replacement, leak detection, valve repair, controller and smart-timer programming, zone troubleshooting and coverage correction, backflow testing, and seasonal winterization. This is the service AlaTex was founded on.

### Irrigation Systems
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/commercial-irrigation

Design, installation, and management of residential and commercial irrigation systems, including new zones, system expansion, smart weather-responsive controllers, leak and pressure repair, and water-efficiency optimization.

### Commercial Landscaping & Maintenance
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/commercial-maintenance-tuscaloosa

Zero-disruption landscape maintenance and accountability for corporate parks, retail centers, HOAs, and institutional properties — scheduled mowing and trimming, seasonal plantings, mulch, pruning, and proactive reporting.

### Commercial Landscaping & Grounds Maintenance (Overview)
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/commercial

The hub for commercial clients — property managers and facilities directors. Covers year-round grounds-maintenance contracts, commercial irrigation, property-management accounts, landscape construction, drainage, and zero-disruption scheduling. AlaTex serves office parks, corporate campuses, retail centers, quick-service restaurants, industrial facilities, multi-family communities, and HOAs.

---

## Service Areas

AlaTex Landscaping treats every community as a primary market. All services above are available in each area below.

### Hoover, AL
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/landscaping/hoover-al
Alabama's largest suburb (Jefferson & Shelby County), including Riverchase, Ross Bridge, and The Preserve. Hoover's red-clay soil makes grading, French drains, and engineered retaining walls especially important.

### Vestavia Hills, AL
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/landscaping/vestavia-hills-al
The City of Vestavia Hills (Jefferson & Shelby County), including Liberty Park and Cahaba Heights. Steep, wooded lots make retaining walls, drainage, and erosion control a priority.

### Mountain Brook, AL
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/landscaping/mountain-brook-al
Mountain Brook (Jefferson County), including Crestline, English Village, and Mountain Brook Village. Estate properties with mature tree canopies that demand high-end landscape construction, lighting, and irrigation.

### Irondale, AL
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/landscaping/irondale-al
Irondale (Jefferson County), the "Whistle Stop" city. Growing residential and commercial corridors that need durable drainage and retaining systems.

### Tuscaloosa, AL
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/landscaping/tuscaloosa-al
Tuscaloosa (Tuscaloosa County), West Alabama. Residential estates and commercial properties needing drainage built for heavy West Alabama rainfall.

### Northport, AL
**URL**: https://www.alatexirrigation.com/landscaping/northport-al
Northport (Tuscaloosa County). Riverside lots and growing subdivisions that call for smart drainage and resilient hardscaping.

## Key Differentiators

1. **Founder-led, sprinkler-repair roots** — owner Bryan Moore built the company hands-on, starting with irrigation and sprinkler repair.
2. **Full-service** — landscape construction, drainage, retaining walls, outdoor lighting, irrigation, sprinkler repair, and maintenance under one roof.
3. **Built for Alabama soil and weather** — drainage and retaining systems engineered for red-clay soils and heavy rainfall.
4. **Residential and commercial** — from single-home projects to corporate and HOA contracts.
5. **Fully licensed & insured.**

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What areas do you serve?**
Hoover, Vestavia Hills, Mountain Brook, Irondale, Tuscaloosa, and Northport, Alabama, plus the greater Birmingham metro and West Alabama.

**What services do you offer?**
Landscaping, landscape construction, drainage and French drains, retaining walls, outdoor lighting, sprinkler repair, irrigation systems, and commercial maintenance.

**Do you build retaining walls?**
Yes — engineered segmental, boulder, and structural retaining walls with built-in drainage to hold slopes and stop erosion.

**Do you repair sprinkler systems?**
Yes — broken heads, leaks, valves, controllers, coverage problems, and full system tune-ups across all service areas.

**Do you install outdoor lighting?**
Yes — low-voltage landscape and architectural lighting, including smart LED systems, plus repair of existing systems.

**Do you handle drainage problems?**
Yes — French drains, regrading, catch basins, and drainage-integrated retaining walls to eliminate standing water and protect foundations.

**Are you licensed and insured?**
Yes, AlaTex Landscaping is fully licensed and insured.
